pages.text: The Stalker is the beloved version of a Creeper. Through the impregnation, the Creeper's body splits vertically and a giant eye grows forth from that rupture. This process also results in losing its ability to explode, so it will just follow around its target. Proximity to a Stalker is a memetic hazard to people and it causes a temporary loss of vision. It can drop a $(l:materials/stalker_eye)$(c)$(o)Stalker Eye$() when killed.
Even though its eye glows in the dark, it can still be surprisingly stealthy.

pages.title: Addendum
pages.text: There are a couple theories on the behaviours of Creepers. Some say it's a sort of territorial plant, which attacks any threats to the environment to protect it. A much more popular theory suggests creepers are actually rather friendly. The reason they explode is simply due to 'anxiety'. If that's the case, the Stalker is a creeper with no anxiety. And as long as the vision loss is dealt with - by wearing an Eye on the head -
they can keep you company decently well, assuming the giant eye staring at you doesn't cause discomfort. At this point, I think I got used to it.
